info.description: # [kwr-21@paypal.com](https://mailto:kwr-21@paypal.com) API Documentation ## Overview This collection contains API endpoints for interacting with PayPal services associated with the account [kwr-21@paypal.com](https://mailto:kwr-21@paypal.com). The collection includes requests for accessing PayPal.me payment links and related functionality. ## Base URL ``` https://paypal.me ``` ## Authentication This collection currently does not specify authentication at the collection level. Individual requests may require authentication depending on the PayPal API endpoint being accessed. For PayPal APIs, common authentication methods include: - **OAuth 2.0**: Bearer tokens for accessing protected resources - **API Credentials**: Client ID and Secret for server-to-server authentication Refer to [PayPal's Developer Documentation](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/overview/) for detailed authentication requirements. ## Variables This collection does not currently define any collection-level variables. Consider adding variables for: - `baseUrl`: The base URL for PayPal services - `username`: Your PayPal.me username - `locale`: Locale settings (e.g., en_US) - `country`: Country code (e.g., US) ## Endpoints ### 1\. Access Token / PayPal.me Payment Link **Request Name**: `access_token$production$wpw3gn5kmywp5frc$03880228e02733bef25b935db795db46` **Method**: `GET` **Endpoint**: `/kwr21` **Full URL**: ``` https://paypal.me/kwr21?country.x=US&locale.x=en_US/1000000 ``` **Description**: This endpoint accesses a PayPal.me payment link for the user kwr21. PayPal.me links provide a simple way to request and receive payments by sharing a personalized URL. **Query Parameters**: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `country.x` | string | No | Country code for localization | `US` | | `locale.x` | string | No | Locale setting for language and region | `en_US` | **Headers**: No custom headers specified. **Request Body**: None (GET request) **Response**: Returns an HTML page for the PayPal.me payment interface where users can: - View the payment recipient's information - Enter a payment amount - Complete the payment transaction **Example Response** (200 OK): ``` html PayPal.me payment page content --> Payment interface --> ``` **Status Codes**: - `200 OK`: Successfully retrieved the PayPal.me payment page - `404 Not Found`: PayPal.me username not found - `500 Internal Server Error`: Server error occurred ## Scripts ### Collection-Level Scripts **Pre-request Script**: None **Test Script**: None ### Request-Level Scripts No pre-request or test scripts are currently defined for the requests in this collection. ## Usage Examples ### Making a Payment Request To use the PayPal.me link: 1. Send a GET request to the endpoint 2. The response will be an HTML page that can be opened in a browser 3. Users can enter the payment amount and complete the transaction ### Customizing the Payment Amount You can append an amount to the URL to pre-fill the payment amount: ``` https://paypal.me/kwr21/50.00 ``` This will set the default payment amount to $50.00. ## Additional Resources - [PayPal Developer Documentation](https://developer.paypal.com/) - [PayPal.me Help Center](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/) - [PayPal API Reference](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/overview/) ## Support For issues related to PayPal APIs or PayPal.me functionality, please contact: - PayPal Developer Support: [https://developer.paypal.com/support/](https://developer.paypal.com/support/) - PayPal Help Center: [https://www.paypal.com/help/](https://www.paypal.com/help/) ## Version History - **Current Version**: 1.0 - **Last Updated**: 2025 --- _This documentation was automatically generated for the_ [kwr-21@paypal.com](https://mailto:kwr-21@paypal.com) _collection._
